senses.sense_definition: A specific arrangement or variation of a set of things.

examples.text: The team considered every possible <w>permutation</w> of the schedule before making a final decision.
This new <w>permutation</w> of the product design is much more efficient than the previous version.

senses.sense_definition: A specific linear ordering of a finite set of distinct elements.

examples.text: Calculating the number of <w>permutation</w> possibilities is a fundamental task in combinatorics.
The <w>permutation</w> of the letters in the word changes its sequence entirely.

senses.sense_definition: A mathematical function that maps a finite set onto itself in a one-to-one manner.

examples.text: The group theory lecture explained how a <w>permutation</w> acts on a set of vertices.
Every <w>permutation</w> can be decomposed into a product of disjoint cycles.

senses.sense_definition: A musical transformation of a set of notes using operations like transposition or inversion.

examples.text: The composer used a complex <w>permutation</w> of the tone row to create the melody.
Each <w>permutation</w> of the theme adds a new layer of harmonic interest to the piece.
